axisDefinition: Volume-equivalent ellipsoid; the axes are the stated ratios with Z as the spin axis. With unit ratios this is a sphere.
measurement: R-band photometry of the bare nucleus at large heliocentric distance
scaleQualification: The published effective nucleus radius is used as a volume-equivalent display radius. This is an explicit scale convention, not a measured volume or set of physical axis lengths.
qualification: Smooth parameter-based approximation of an unresolved nucleus. Lightcurves give an axis ratio of at least 1.3, used here as the displayed elongation, with a period between 7.2 and 12.8 hours. No local shape features, concavities, surface textures, coma or tail are claimed.
